english.title: Driver fail to give vehicle owner name /address to a constable following accident / suspected offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a
motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(D)_[whom a traffic warden had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(E)_[whom a traffic warden had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a
motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(F)_[whom a vehicle examiner had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(G)_[whom a vehicle examiner had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a
motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a

(H)_[constable,]_
(I)_[traffic warden,]_
(J)_[vehicle examiner,]_

failed to give the name and address of the owner of the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drive a motor vehicle on a road
at the time of accident/committing offence

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For the comparable offence in relation to an accident only in a public place see H72.
(ii) This offence wording relates to motor vehicles other than invalid carriages.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) The offence was extended to include 'other public place' by the The Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) Regulations 2000 - S.I. 726/2000 refers.
